race.comment: The winning run of MISS AUSTRALIANA (5) came to an end last start but it was in stronger company than this and she was far from disgraced when beaten 4.4m after being held up. Had made it four wins on the trot when scoring at this circuit and distance prior. Can bounce back. SEA SALT (2) will find this easier than when she took on a good field of mares at Listed level first up. Had ended last campaign with three straight Adelaide wins. Draws well so look for big improvement. POPS JOY (3) hasn't been far away since recording back-to-back placings at this circuit and distance last month. Gets her lowest draw for some time so is a chance to break through as is MCWIZARD (7) who came from a similar draw and missed narrowly as runner-up last week, his fourth successive placing at this circuit and distance.
